en.headline: 999 callers to send real-time audio and video from 2028, Tang says
en.dek: Security minister Chris Tang outlined three new functions for the emergency hotline, including instant multimedia transfer to Fire Services and call prioritisation in major incidents.
body: Callers to Hong Kong’s 999 emergency hotline will be able to send real-time audio, image and video data via common messaging apps from 2028, Secretary for Security Chris Tang Ping-keung said on Thursday.

Speaking at a press conference on the first five-year plan and the 2026 Policy Address, Tang said the upgrade would add three functions. Members of the public would be able to transmit sound, pictures and video in real time to help control centres assess the scene more quickly.

Related incident information would also be sent instantly to the Fire Services Department to speed up deployment of rescue resources. A third function would use new technology to prioritise the most critical calls when lines are busy or during major incidents.

Tang emphasised that every second counts in saving lives and that more accurate information allows faster rescue. Authorities would advance the work in stages, with the aim of enabling the new features as soon as possible in 2028.

The announcement followed the Policy Address, which had already signalled enhancements to 999 services. Tang noted that the full upgrade represented both a technological advance and a practical step to give people in need quicker help.

zh.headline: 鄧炳強：999熱線2028年增實時傳影音功能
zh.dek: 保安局局長表示將新增三項功能，包括市民用通訊軟件即時傳送聲影畫、資料即時轉交消防，以及繁忙時優先處理危急個案。
body: 保安局局長鄧炳強周四表示，999緊急求助熱線將於2028年新增功能，讓市民可透過常用通訊軟件即時傳送聲、影、畫資料。
鄧炳強在香港第一個五年規劃及2026年《施政報告》相關措施記者會上指出，警隊未來會為999服務新增三項功能。市民可以使用常用通訊軟件即時傳送聲影畫資料，協助控制中心更快掌握現場情況。
相關報案資訊亦會即時傳送至消防處，加快調配救援。警隊亦會以新技術分流來電，在重大事故或線路繁忙時優先處理最危急個案。
鄧炳強強調，救人分秒必爭，資訊愈快愈準，救援就可以更快一步。當局會逐步推進相關工作，期望2028年可以盡快啟用。
他形容999服務全面升級不單是科技上的進步，更重要是爭取每一分每一秒，令有需要的市民更快得到救援。
